reviewer: independent analyst /root/synthesis_finish; not bundled workflow packet author
scope: Independent semantic and integrity review of broader documentary workflows for Analog, Collision, Corpus, Electric, Tension, Amp and Cabinet. Approval establishes neither complete device profiles, exact Live 12.4.3 applicability, expanded finite DSP evidence, implementation input, release suitability nor compatibility.

checks.semantic_source_review: Read all 41 D12 contracts with their cited retained paragraphs across the seven profiles and all 118 case actions. Clauses preserve public section, eligibility, routing/copy, envelope/glide, LFO/unison, modulation, MIDI and microphone roles without deriving private synthesis, voice budgets, mode coefficients, random distributions, codecs, event rounding or tolerances.
checks.grading: All 118 cases have target expected/comparison null, target_grade U and executed false. The 33 documentary control/state oracles are scoped to visible controls or exposed state. Eight signal-obligation and 77 lifecycle/investigation cases have null documentary oracles too; source wording is not an exact-target audio or timing oracle.
checks.version_boundaries: Both retained official manuals are Version 12 publications. Their retained capture identities are preserved; every new runtime clause remains exact-12.4.3 U. Existing extracted-original finite evidence is not a Live application run or a broader version/control parity claim.
checks.authority_boundaries: Existing bundled parameter owners retain storage, domains, labels, defaults and malformed-reader behavior. Bundled hosting retains its conditional Amp/Cabinet composition and external wet dependency. Existing Analog, Collision, Corpus, Electric and Tension audio authorities and all five immutable releases remain unchanged; no documentary clause expands their finite outputs or controller coverage.
checks.context_cautions: Collision serial/both-resonators wording and Tube open/closed descriptions remain research cautions, not new topology or physical-model laws. Corpus Dry/Wet admission wording distinguishes existing tails from new excitation and does not replace its constant-parameter mix owner. Cabinet placement and microphone type remain distinct control roles.
checks.positive_controls: F0, positive-path-guard and device setups require admitted active routes, nonzero excitation/output, nonzero relevant modulation/wet contribution and a matched positive baseline before no-effect tests. Collision excludes the silent constructor; Tension requires a productive exciter/string patch. Corpus separates prior resonance from new input and retains donor/source identity. Missing excitation, mute or inactive modulation remains inconclusive.
checks.blocked_execution: Amp/Cabinet wet audio prerequisites are explicitly future and unproven. No host-emulation, fake identity, platform shim, original/native function, runtime, installation or candidate execution is authorized or performed by these fixtures or this review.
checks.lifecycle: Each device has explicit negative, boundary, automation, persistence, undo, malformed, cancel, transport, sample-rate, teardown and MPE/tuning investigation cases. Unsupported controls, unavailable fixtures and unproven numerical or lifecycle expectations remain U/null; Amp/Cabinet gain no inferred internal LFO or instrument MPE source.
checks.author_validator: Inspected validate.py and import behavior before running python3 -B analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/bundled-workflows/validate.py read-only: pass. It reproduces all 401 block texts/lines/headings and checks source/catalog pins, all release payload hashes, counts, IDs, case guards, browser discovery, snapshots, links, manifest inventory and untracked-aware whitespace. Sealed validation output was not rewritten.
checks.independent_integrity_check: Separately recomputed all 25 manifest payload byte counts/hashes, requirement provenance/counts, 118 target oracle invariants, 33 documentary oracles and the exact browser ID set outside the author checker: pass. Manifest SHA remained the assigned seal after review.

nonblocking_followup.note: These are finite documentary checks and future investigation recipes, not executable acceptance or exhaustive state/control combinations. Before future execution, retain exact accepted control values, per-branch mode/routes, audio/controller bytes and independent signal/timing/statistical metrics. Conditional unsupported branches and failed positive prerequisites remain U.

Manual figures were not visually inspected. Only cited text supports this approval. External original manuals, capture catalogs and existing authorities are pinned rather than recopied; reproducibility depends on retaining their referenced paths.
